newsitem.title: HONG KONG: AVIC unit acquires China trust company.
newsitem.headline: AVIC unit acquires China trust company.

text.p: The Shenzhen CATIC Group, a unit of state-owned Aviation Industries of China (AVIC), has acquired the Jiangxi Trust and Investment Co Ltd, an official press report said on Thursday.
The trust company's securities operation had expanded rapidly since it was bought by Shenzhen CATIC (China Aviation Technology Import Co), the Shenzhen-based Securities Times said.
The trust firm is under the Agricultural Bank of China and based in southeastern Jiangxi province.
The newspaper said it had a total of 11 securities offices across China, compared with five before the takeover. It gave no further details.
An official at Shenzhen CATIC told the Hong Kong-based newsletter China Securities Bulletin the takeover was completed in May. She declined to give further details.
Analysts said the move was aimed at complying with Beijing's policy mandating the divestment by banks of their securities operations.

Shenzhen CATIC, AVIC's investment arm in the southern Chinese boomtown neighbouring Hong Kong, is mulling an H share listing in the territory, which reverts to Chinese rule on July 1, some time this year.
H shares are offered by mainland China-incorporated companies listed in Hong Kong.
Another Shenzhen CATIC official said the company was still preparing for the share offer but he declined further comment.
The group is among the latest, fourth-batch of state-run companies approved by Beijing to seek overseas listing.

The group controls three Shenzhen-listed companies -- watchmaker Shenzhen Fiyta Holdings Ltd, bicycle maker and hotelier Shenzhen Nanguang (Group) Co Ltd, and crystal display producer Shenzhen Microelectronics Co, the newspaper said.

The group, a conglomerate involved in high-technology, trading, property, tourism and finance, planned to float only part of its assets on the Hong Kong bourse, another Shenzhen CATIC analyst said, without elaborating.
